Distant signals in France ('''signaux à distance''': [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in France#Avertissement|Avertissement]] or [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in France#Disque|Disque]]) are always presented on an R-type signal head ('''châssis-écran de type R'''). The shape is therefore implicit and {{TagKey|railway:signal:distant:shape}} is not used.
